newsitem.title: FINLAND: NIINISTO'S BUDGET SETS DEBT CEILING - CONSERVATIVES.
newsitem.headline: NIINISTO'S BUDGET SETS DEBT CEILING - CONSERVATIVES.

text.p: The Finnish Conservative Party's parliamentary group said on Tuesday that Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto's budget proposal set an absolute ceiling for the state's increasing debt.
"The group also sees that the goverment should accelerate the development which will through savings lead to true budget balancing," it said in a statement.
The group spoke in favour of the moderate wage agreement to maintain low inflation. "This would give chances for lowering income taxation," it said.
"The labour market organisations' responsibility for the autumn's settlement will be essential," it said.
